target.title: docs: finish release closeout
target.body:
## Summary

- add durable product boundaries for BlackBar's native, glanceable, local-first scope
- keep both website download buttons on GitHub's latest release instead of hard-coding an old version
- record the user-visible website fix in the 0.2.5 changelog

The truthful-current-state policy preserves the reusable decision behind https://github.com/steipete/BlackBar/pull/4. This batch follows the release-helper repair already landed in https://github.com/steipete/BlackBar/pull/5.

## Proof

- `make ci` — 25 tests passed; signing-cleanup regression passed; release build and universal app bundle succeeded
- `curl -sSIL https://github.com/steipete/BlackBar/releases/latest` — HTTP 200; resolves to https://github.com/steipete/BlackBar/releases/tag/v0.2.4
- static assertions confirm exactly two `/releases/latest` links and no remaining v0.2.3 download target
- structured Codex autoreview — clean; no accepted/actionable findings

## Risk

Low: three documentation/site files, 33 additions and 2 deletions; no app runtime, dependency, credential, signing, version, tag, or release mutation.

Rendered-browser proof remains pending; hosted Pages deployment occurs from `main` after merge.

No version bump, tag, publish, or release was performed.
